title: A tidier screen
changes: Every part of the screen now has its own place: prompts, the level-up note, chords and buffs no longer pile on top of each other.
The top right is one neat column: online count, minimap, place name, quests and the kill feed, with nothing running off the edge.
Skill bar numbers stay readable on smaller screens, and cooldown and potion counts stay inside their slots.
Chat and group frames get a light backing so they are easier to read, and names hide when they would sit under the minimap.
